name: com.meshy.cache
description:
Browse Meshy community AI-generated 3D models from a BigQuery RAG and import them into Unity with automatic mesh simplification (UnityMeshSimplifier), texture compression, and per-suffix TextureImporter settings. Includes a 3-view render probe for visually verifying imports.

Requires a small Python bridge process (HTTP localhost) for the BigQuery vector search + the headless-browser Meshy GLB capture. See PythonBridge~/README.md.
